newsitem.title: USA: Sync sees profits in two to four quarters.
newsitem.headline: Sync sees profits in two to four quarters.

text.p: Sync Research Inc on Tuesday said it would probably take two to four quarters before the computer networking company could achieve profitability.

"Sync is confident its long-term prospects are on track, but expects that it will take two to four quarters to regain significant revenue momentum and achieve profitability," Sync said in a statement.
Earlier, the company said its first-quarter loss widened to $0.36 a share from a loss of $0.10 in the same period last year. Sales dropped to $5.0 million from $9.0 million.
"The results for the first quarter were a major disappointment," Roger Dorf, chief executive officer, said in a statement.
He also called the first-quarter results "a clear signal that we needed to make some adjustments."
Sync has integrated its sales forces and consolidated and reduced other functions in order to cut operating expenses by more than 20 percent from the first quarter.
Dorf also said its balance sheet, with cash and short-term investments of $30.2 million, represented a positive factor for the company.
Sync shares fell 3/16 to 2-15/16 on Tuesday.
